therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: natriuretic peptide receptor A (NPR-A / guanylyl cyclase A)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation to reduce cardiac preload and afterload while preserving renal perfusion
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with both cardiac failure and renal failure
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: unexpected rehospitalization for cardiovascular events, uremic symptoms, initiation of maintenance dialysis, and kidney transplantation at 6 months and 2 years

context.indication: heart failure with concurrent renal failure
context.comparator: standard heart failure therapy (loop diuretics, aldosterone blockers, beta blockers, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, nitrates, digitalis)
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated; no reason was stated in the registry record.

results_by_chain.endpoint: composite rehospitalization/renal events at 6 months and 2 years
results_by_chain.biology_description: natriuresis and vasodilation reducing cardiac preload and preserving renal perfusion
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with concurrent cardiac failure and renal failure
